name: Compliance Pack
tagline: Logging an auditor can sit with.
summary: HIPAA-guardrailed logging, ASC 842 / regulated-filing alignment, and audit exports formatted for external review. Credible because the healthcare and compliance verticals already exist.
description: Compliance Pack is the regulated overlay on the audit trail. Healthcare gets HIPAA-oriented logging and workflow guardrails. Finance/compliance gets ASC 842 and regulated-filing support from the existing compliance vertical. Both get reviewer-ready evidence packages built on the existing audit logger and vertical-specific workflows. The setup fee covers guardrail configuration, retention, and the first export path.
buyer: Healthcare RCM, clinic ops, or a finance/compliance team whose agents touch PHI, filings, leases, or other externally reviewable workflows.

features.name: HIPAA-guardrailed logging
features.detail: Healthcare workflows already ship PHI-aware guardrails and audit helpers.

features.name: ASC 842 / regulated-filing alignment
features.detail: Compliance vertical workflows already include lease-accounting and regulatory automation surfaces.

features.name: External-review exports
features.detail: Reviewer packages can include event hashes, signatures, access attribution, and retention statements.

features.name: Setup & guardrail configuration
features.detail: The setup fee covers scope, retention, export path, and reviewer-specific guardrail setup.

includes: OBS-02 capabilities under the compliance overlay
